summary: Implemented terminal window title support (uncommitted, tests not run per instructions). Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE=16 and widens ControlCode to accept (ControlType, str). rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format "\x1b]0;{title}\x07", a Control.title(title) classmethod that strips BEL and ESC from the title (my addition, to prevent early sequence termination), and a _TITLE_TRANSLATE table. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, which writes only when is_terminal and not legacy_windows. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added entry. Tests appended to tests/test_control.py and tests/test_console.py. Not verified by running; the Windows legacy renderer silently ignores the new control type.
